episode_title: Construction Marketing is Changing. Is Your Brand Ready? | With Natalie Davies, Heidelberg Materials

real_qa.q: How do AI platforms impact B2B procurement and vendor selection in construction?
real_qa.r: AI platforms are creating a new type of search for procurement professionals who use them to cross-compare and create lists of businesses meeting specific criteria before sending tenders or RFPs. If brands do not create the right content and give proper signals to AI platforms, they may never even make it onto the vendor comparison list in the first place.

real_qa.q: What is the conversion rate for B2B businesses on Claude AI compared to traditional search?
real_qa.r: Claude has on average across B2B a 15% conversion rate, compared to traditional search which ranges between 1 to 2 percent. This indicates that AI platforms are providing answers and summarizing content in a digestible way that encourages users to convert, whether that is submitting a lead or making a purchase.
real_qa.requete: B2B conversion rate Claude AI vs Google search

real_qa.q: How much does zero-click rate increase when an AI overview is present in search results?
real_qa.r: Zero-click rates increase from approximately 34% without an AI overview to about 44% when one is present. This means that when a query is answered directly within the AI overview, a significant chunk of traffic that would otherwise click through to websites is lost.
real_qa.requete: AI overview zero-click rate search results

guest.bio_context: Natalie Davies has worked in construction marketing for 10 years and is passionate about the industry's evolution, particularly in sustainability and lower carbon products. She describes construction as an industry where professionals stay for life, and emphasizes how marketing plays a vital role in communicating the future-building work of construction companies.

real_quote: Traditional search technical SEO is like building a house; technical SEO is the foundation, and without getting that right, even the best content will never reach its maximum potential.
